newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Brambles sees several A$100 mln buys.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Brambles sees several A$100 mln buys.

text.p: Transport, logistics and security group Brambles Industries Ltd said on Friday it expected to make two or three acquisitions worth about A$100 million each in Europe and the United States during 1996/97.

"They're going to be in the order of A$100 million but there might be two or three. You're unlikely to see us go bang with a big one," Brambles chief executive John Fletcher told reporters after the company's annual meeting.
Fletcher said the acquisitions could be funded without having to resort to a capital raising.
He said the buys were unlikely to be associated with the company's CHEP pallet business.

Chairman Alan Coates earlier said he would not comment on the participation of Brambles with Lend Lease Corp and the Irish government's Aer Rianta in the tender process for the proposed sale of Australian airports.

"It is far too early for any constructive comment in this regard and a great deal of work will need to be done before any decision is taken on the detail of any tender we might make," he told shareholders.
